title: Taking an unattended-but-'watched' item (e.g. the headframe lantern) costs a companion's regard immediately and irreversibly, with no warning that it's treated as real theft rather than a minor scavenging action, even though many similar 'take X (NPC watching: theft)' prompts elsewhere had no apparent consequence when skipped.
